environment.description: EC2 instance (c5.large) running the Flask monolith directly exposed via an ALB with public DNS. No CDN layer. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The ALB forwards requests directly to the EC2 target group on port 8080. No rate limiting configured. Network latency from attacker to origin is consistent (~2ms jitter). Instance runs in us-east-1a with enhanced networking (ENA) providing sub-microsecond timing precision.
